hpe_alloc.brief: 分配一块堆内存 / Allocate a block of heap memory

params.size: 请求的字节数（0 视为 1）/ Requested byte count, 0 is treated as 1

hpe_alloc.return: 指向新内存的指针 / Pointer to the new block
hpe_alloc.note: 分配失败时打印错误并 abort，绝不返回 NULL / Prints an error and aborts on failure, never returns NULL

hpe_calloc.brief: 分配并清零一块堆内存 / Allocate a zeroed block of heap memory

params.count: 元素个数（0 视为 1）/ Element count, 0 is treated as 1
params.size: 单个元素字节数（0 视为 1）/ Byte size of one element, 0 is treated as 1

hpe_calloc.return: 指向已清零内存的指针 / Pointer to the zeroed block
hpe_calloc.note: 分配失败时打印错误并 abort，绝不返回 NULL / Prints an error and aborts on failure, never returns NULL

hpe_realloc.brief: 调整已分配内存块的大小 / Resize an allocated memory block

params.ptr: 原内存块，可为 NULL / Previous block, may be NULL
params.size: 新字节数（0 视为 1）/ New byte count, 0 is treated as 1

hpe_realloc.return: 指向新内存块的指针 / Pointer to the resized block
hpe_realloc.warning: 失败时 abort，因此调用方无需检查 NULL / Aborts on failure, so callers need not check for NULL

hpe_strdup.brief: 复制字符串到新分配的堆内存 / Duplicate a string onto the heap

params.s: 以 NUL 结尾的源字符串 / NUL-terminated source string

hpe_strdup.return: 新分配的副本，调用方负责释放 / Newly allocated copy owned by the caller

hpe_strndup.brief: 复制字符串的前 n 个字节 / Duplicate the first n bytes of a string

params.n: 最多复制的字节数 / Maximum number of bytes to copy

hpe_strndup.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的副本 / Newly allocated NUL-terminated copy
hpe_strndup.note: 遇到 `\0` 提前结束；结果长度取 n 与 strlen(s) 的较小者 / Stops early at `\0`; the copy is min(n, strlen(s)) bytes long

hpe_free.brief: 释放引擎分配的内存 / Free memory allocated by the engine

params.ptr: 待释放的指针，可为 NULL / Pointer to free, may be NULL

hpe_grow.brief: 按需倍增数组容量 / Grow an array's capacity by repeated doubling

params.ptr: 原数组，可为 NULL / Previous array, may be NULL
params.cap: out:当前容量，写入新容量 / Current capacity, receives the new one
params.need: 需要的元素个数 / Required element count
params.elem_size: 单个元素字节数 / Byte size of one element

hpe_grow.return: 必要时重新分配后的数组指针 / Reallocated array pointer when growth was needed
hpe_grow.note: 容量不足时从 8 起翻倍直到覆盖 need；已够用时原样返回 / Doubles from 8 until `need` fits; returns the input untouched when it already does

hpe_ascii_lower.brief: 把 ASCII 大写字母转为小写 / Lowercase an ASCII letter
hpe_ascii_lower.return: 小写形式，非大写字母原样返回 / Lowercased character, other inputs unchanged

hpe_str_ieq.brief: 忽略大小写比较两个字符串 / Compare two strings case-insensitively

params.a: 第一个字符串，可为 NULL / First string, may be NULL
params.b: 第二个字符串，可为 NULL / Second string, may be NULL

hpe_str_ieq.note: 两个指针同为 NULL 时视为相等 / Two NULL pointers compare equal

hpe_str_ieq_n.brief: 忽略大小写比较两个字符串的前 n 个字节 / Compare the first n bytes of two strings case-insensitively

params.a: 第一个字符串 / First string
params.b: 第二个字符串 / Second string
params.n: 比较的字节数 / Number of bytes to compare

hpe_str_ieq_n.return: 前 n 个字节都相同返回 1 / 1 when the first n bytes match

hpe_starts_with_i.brief: 忽略大小写判断字符串是否以某前缀开头 / Test whether a string starts with a prefix, case-insensitively

params.s: 待检查字符串 / String to inspect
params.prefix: 前缀 / Prefix to look for

hpe_starts_with_i.return: 以前缀开头返回 1 / 1 when the prefix matches

hpe_is_space.brief: 判断字符是否为 ASCII 空白 / Test whether a character is ASCII whitespace
hpe_is_space.note: 空白集合为空格、`\t`、`\n`、`\r`、`\f`、`\v` / The set is space, `\t`, `\n`, `\r`, `\f` and `\v`

hpe_trim.brief: 就地去除字符串首尾空白 / Trim leading and trailing whitespace in place

params.s: 可修改的字符串，可为 NULL / Mutable string, may be NULL

hpe_trim.return: 去掉前导空白后的起始指针 / Pointer past the leading whitespace
hpe_trim.warning: 会写入 s 的内容，不可传字符串字面量 / Writes into `s`, so never pass a string literal

hpe_utf8_next.brief: 解码下一个 UTF-8 码点 / Decode the next UTF-8 code point

params.s: 指向码点起始字节 / Points at the first byte of the code point
params.cp: out:解码出的码点 / Decoded code point

hpe_utf8_next.return: 消耗的字节数（至少 1）/ Number of bytes consumed, at least 1
hpe_utf8_next.note: 非法序列写出 U+FFFD 并只前进 1 字节，因此不会死循环 / Illegally encoded sequences yield U+FFFD and advance one byte, so the caller never loops

hpe_utf8_prev.brief: 向前回退一个 UTF-8 码点 / Step back one UTF-8 code point

params.begin: 缓冲区起始指针 / Start of the buffer

hpe_utf8_prev.return: 回退消耗的字节数，已在起始处返回 0 / Bytes to step back, 0 when already at `begin`
hpe_utf8_prev.note: 只扫描 continuation 字节（`0b10xxxxxx`）/ Only continuation bytes are scanned

hpe_utf8_encode.brief: 把一个码点编码为 UTF-8 / Encode a code point as UTF-8

params.cp: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point
params.out: out:至少 4 字节的输出缓冲 / Output buffer of at least 4 bytes

hpe_utf8_encode.return: 写出的字节数（1~4）/ Number of bytes written, 1 to 4
hpe_utf8_encode.note: 不做范围校验，码点大于 U+10FFFF 时按 4 字节写入 / Range is not validated; code points above U+10FFFF are still written as 4 bytes

hpe_len_auto.brief: 构造 `auto` 长度 / Build an `auto` length
hpe_len_auto.return: 单位为 `HPE_LEN_AUTO` 的长度值 / A length whose unit is `HPE_LEN_AUTO`

hpe_len_px.brief: 构造像素长度 / Build a pixel length
hpe_len_px.return: 单位为 `HPE_LEN_PX` 的长度值 / A length whose unit is `HPE_LEN_PX`

hpe_len_pct.brief: 构造百分比长度 / Build a percentage length

params.v: 百分比数值（未除 100）/ Percentage value, not divided by 100

hpe_len_pct.return: 单位为 `HPE_LEN_PCT` 的长度值 / A length whose unit is `HPE_LEN_PCT`

hpe_len_unit.brief: 按指定单位构造长度 / Build a length with an explicit unit
hpe_len_unit.return: 构造出的长度值 / The constructed length

hpe_len_is_px.brief: 判断长度是否为绝对像素值 / Test whether a length is an absolute pixel value

params.len: 待检查长度 / Length to inspect

hpe_len_is_px.return: 单位为 px 返回 1 / 1 when the unit is px
hpe_len_is_px.note: 解析期已把物理单位换算为 px，因此此类长度无需上下文即可求值 / Physical units were already converted at parse time, so no layout context is needed to resolve it

hpe_len_is_auto.brief: 判断长度是否为 `auto` / Test whether a length is `auto`

params.len: 待检查长度 / Length to inspect

len_unit_from_suffix.brief: 把单位后缀映射为长度单位枚举 / Map a unit suffix to a length unit

params.s: 单位后缀，如 `rem`、`vh` / Unit suffix such as `rem` or `vh`
params.out: out:映射到的单位 / Mapped unit

len_unit_from_suffix.return: 识别成功返回 1 / 1 when the suffix was recognised
len_unit_from_suffix.details: 后缀按最长优先匹配，避免 `vmin` 被 `vh` 抢先、`rem` 被 `em` 抢先。| Suffixes are matched longest-first so that `vmin` does not shadow `vh` and `rem` does not shadow `em`.
len_unit_from_suffix.note: `ex` 归入 em、`pc`/`pt` 归入 pt、`in`/`cm`/`mm`/`q` 归入 px / `ex` maps to em, `pc` and `pt` to pt, `in`/`cm`/`mm`/`q` to px

hpe_len_parse.brief: 解析 CSS 长度字面量 / Parse a CSS length literal

params.s: 长度文本，可为 NULL / Length text, may be NULL

hpe_len_parse.return: 解析出的长度值 / The parsed length
hpe_len_parse.note: 支持 `auto`、`%`、`px`、`em`、`rem`、`vw`、`vh`、`ch`、`pt`、`pc`、`in`、`cm`、`mm`、`q`；物理单位按 96dpi 立即折算为 px，无法识别时按 px 处理 / Accepts `auto`, `%`, `px`, `em`, `rem`, `vw`, `vh`, `ch`, `pt`, `pc`, `in`, `cm`, `mm` and `q`; physical units become px at 96dpi and unrecognised suffixes fall back to px

hpe_len_resolve.brief: 把长度按基准值求值为像素 / Resolve a length against a single base value

params.len: 待求值长度 / Length to resolve
params.base: 百分比基准（通常为包含块宽度）/ Percentage base, normally the containing block width

hpe_len_resolve.return: 像素值；`auto` 返回 -1 / Pixel value, or -1 for `auto`
hpe_len_resolve.note: 相对单位（em/rem/vw/vh/ch）一律按 0 上下文求值，等价于传全 0 给 hpe_len_resolve_full / Relative units are resolved with an all-zero context

hpe_len_resolve_full.brief: 带完整上下文地把长度求值为像素 / Resolve a length to pixels with a full context

params.len: 待求值长度 / Length to resolve
params.base: 百分比基准（包含块宽度或高度）/ Percentage base
params.font_size: 元素自身字号，供 em 使用（0 视为 16）/ Element font size for em, 0 falls back to 16
params.root_font_size: 根元素字号，供 rem 使用（0 视为 16）/ Root font size for rem, 0 falls back to 16
params.vw: 视口宽度，供 vw 使用 / Viewport width for vw
params.vh: 视口高度，供 vh 使用 / Viewport height for vh
params.ch_width: `0` 字形步进宽度，供 ch 使用 / Advance width of the `0` glyph for ch

hpe_len_resolve_full.return: 像素值；`auto` 返回 -1 / Pixel value, or -1 for `auto`
hpe_len_resolve_full.note: 缺省上下文时 em/rem 退回 16px、vw/vh 退回 16px、ch 退回半字号 / With a missing context em and rem fall back to 16px, vw and vh to 16px, and ch to half the font size

hex_val.brief: 把十六进制字符转成数值 / Convert a hexadecimal digit to its value
hex_val.return: 0~15，非十六进制字符返回 -1 / 0 to 15, or -1 when the character is not a hex digit

hpe_latin1_to_utf8.brief: 把 Latin-1/cp1252 字节流转换为 UTF-8 / Transcode a Latin-1/cp1252 byte stream to UTF-8

params.len: 源字节数 / Source byte count
params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 NULL / Result length in bytes, may be NULL

hpe_latin1_to_utf8.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的 UTF-8 字符串 / Newly allocated NUL-terminated UTF-8 string
hpe_latin1_to_utf8.details: `0x80`~`0x9F` 经 cp1252 表映射（弯引号、破折号、省略号、欧元符号等），其余按 Latin-1 处理。| Bytes `0x80` to `0x9F` go through the cp1252 table (curly quotes, dashes, ellipsis, euro sign, ...), everything else is treated as Latin-1.
hpe_latin1_to_utf8.note: 调用方负责释放返回值 / The caller owns the returned buffer

color_parse_hex_short.brief: 解析 `#rgb` / `#rgba` 短十六进制颜色 / Parse a `#rgb` or `#rgba` short hex colour

params.s: 以 `#` 开头的颜色文本 / Colour text beginning with `#`
params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

color_parse_hex_short.return: 解析成功返回 1 / 1 on success
color_parse_hex_short.note: 每个十六进制位重复一次展开为 8 位分量；4 位形式第 4 位为 alpha / Each digit is doubled to form a full byte; a 4-digit form carries alpha

color_parse_hex_long.brief: 解析 `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa` 长十六进制颜色 / Parse a `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` long hex colour

params.s: 以 `#` 开头的颜色文本 / Colour text beginning with `#`
params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

color_parse_hex_long.return: 解析成功返回 1 / 1 on success
color_parse_hex_long.note: 6 位形式省略 alpha 时视为不透明 / A 6-digit form implies full opacity

color_skip_seps.brief: 跳过函数式颜色参数间的分隔符 / Skip the separators between functional colour arguments

params.pp: inout:读写游标指针 / Read-write cursor pointer

color_skip_seps.note: 分隔符为空格、逗号和斜杠 / The separators are space, comma and slash

color_read_components.brief: 读取 `rgb()` / `hsl()` 参数表里的数值分量 / Read the numeric components of an `rgb()` or `hsl()` argument list

params.p: 指向左括号的文本 / Text pointing at the opening parenthesis
params.comp: out:分量数组，容量至少 4 / Component array of at least 4 slots
params.pct: out:每个分量是否带百分号 / Percent-sign flag per component

color_read_components.return: 实际读到的分量个数（0~4）/ Number of components read, 0 to 4
color_read_components.note: 带 `%` 的 rgb 分量按 255 折算，第 4 个分量（alpha）按 1.0 折算 / Percent-suffixed rgb components scale to 255, while the fourth (alpha) scales to 1.0

clamp01.brief: 把浮点数夹到 [0, 1] / Clamp a float into [0, 1]
clamp01.return: 夹取后的值 / The clamped value

clamp_byte.brief: 把浮点数夹到 [0, 255] 并转为字节 / Clamp a float into [0, 255] and narrow it to a byte
clamp_byte.return: 夹取并取整后的字节 / The clamped byte

color_parse_rgb.brief: 解析 `rgb()` 颜色函数 / Parse an `rgb()` colour function

params.s: 以 `rgb(` 开头的颜色文本 / Colour text beginning with `rgb(`
params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

color_parse_rgb.return: 解析成功返回 1 / 1 on success
color_parse_rgb.note: 支持 `rgb(r, g, b)`、`rgb(r, g, b, a)` 以及各分量的百分比写法 / Accepts `rgb(r, g, b)`, `rgb(r, g, b, a)` and percentage forms

hsl_sextant_rgb.brief: 把色相扇区映射为 HSL 转 RGB 所需的色度三元组 / Map a hue sextant to the chroma triple used by the HSL-to-RGB conversion

params.sextant: 色相扇区 0~5 / Hue sextant, 0 to 5

color_read_hsl_components.brief: 读取 `hsl()` 参数表里的数值分量 / Read the numeric components of an `hsl()` argument list

params.p: 指向左括号的文本 / Text pointing at the opening parenthesis
params.comp: out:分量数组，容量至少 4 / Component array of at least 4 slots

color_read_hsl_components.return: 实际读到的分量个数（0~4）/ Number of components read, 0 to 4
color_read_hsl_components.note: 带 `%` 的分量就地除以 100，得到 0~1 的归一值 / Percent-suffixed components are divided by 100 into the 0..1 range

color_parse_hsl.brief: 解析 `hsl()` 颜色函数 / Parse an `hsl()` colour function

params.s: 以 `hsl(` 开头的颜色文本 / Colour text beginning with `hsl(`
params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

color_parse_hsl.return: 解析成功返回 1 / 1 on success
color_parse_hsl.note: 支持 `hsl(h, s%, l%)` 与带 alpha 的四分量形式；色相按度取模 360 / Accepts `hsl(h, s%, l%)` and the four-component alpha form; hue wraps modulo 360 degrees

color_parse_named.brief: 按具名色表解析颜色 / Resolve a colour from the named-colour table

params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

color_parse_named.return: 命中返回 1 / 1 when the name was found
color_parse_named.note: 表内为完整的 CSS Color 4 具名色（含两种 gray/grey 拼写）与 `transparent` / The table holds the full CSS Color 4 set including both grey spellings and `transparent`

hpe_color_parse.brief: 解析任意 CSS 颜色写法 / Parse any supported CSS colour notation

params.s: 颜色文本，可为 NULL / Colour text, may be NULL
params.out: out:解析出的颜色 / Parsed colour

hpe_color_parse.return: 解析成功返回 1 / 1 on success
hpe_color_parse.note: 依次尝试具名色、`#` 十六进制短/长写法、`rgb()`/`rgba()`、`hsl()`/`hsla()` / Tries named colours, short and long `#` hex, `rgb()`/`rgba()` and `hsl()`/`hsla()`
